scope: Actual transport-position feedback and shared transient Parameter seek arbitration; native decoded playback remains open

product.position: Existing background metadata owner samples actual clock position every 100ms; control actions publish immediately. Delta-only scalar edits use one coalesced inbox per media, with no per-node engine polling rule.
product.arbitration: Manual transient writes record their exact emitted event time. Feedback acknowledges that input and a current producer revision; old feedback cannot overwrite a newer write even before its callback runs. Active edit sessions retain only latest feedback for touched transient targets. Release/disconnect queues it for fresh validation; unrelated targets continue updating.
product.lifetime: Parameter removal clears runtime values, bounds and input markers. Restored media receives a new producer inbox. Runtime feedback stays outside persistence/history and never becomes another seek.
product.bounds: Duration availability has its own revision, so transport changes cannot invalidate unchanged metadata. Pending coalesced status retries its wake at the next existing background checkpoint.
product.stepping: Changing future Speed while paused and repeating Pause preserve the current epoch/frame neighbours; real seek/play discontinuities retain fencing. This repairs immediate mixed-rate Step rejection without waiting for a worker race.
product.schema: Media v11 and Command v8 unchanged; internal trusted Edit fields are not wire DTOs
